title: Riot Squad Pod Liq Strawberry Raspberry Cherry 80ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pod Liq Shortfills are the latest innovation from Riot Squad that let you enjoy the long-lasting value and great flavours of Shortfill E-liquids in a huge variety of vape kits that use higher-resistance coils. Pod Liq’s unique 60%PG/40%VG ratio is tailor-made for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping with its perfect balance of vapour, flavour and throat hit. Available in 120ml bottles with 80ml of 0mg E-liquid, you have the freedom to tailor your nicotine content with the use of Nicotine Shots. Two x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 100ml of 3mg 50/50 E-liquid. While Four x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 120ml of 6mg 50/50 E-liquid. Take your senses on a rollercoaster of flavour with Riot Squad's Strawberry Raspberry Cherry 60/40 Shortfill E-liquid. This concoction is more than just an e-liquid; it's a vibrant tapestry of fruit flavours woven together to create a tantalising experience. Imagine strolling through a lush orchard where each fruit is ripe for picking—this is what each puff delivers. The first inhale envelops your palate with the sweet allure of strawberries, almost as if you've bitten into a freshly picked berry. As the vapour swirls in your mouth, the tartness of raspberries comes into play, adding a punchy contrast that elevates the sweetness to new heights. But the journey doesn't end here. The finishing touch is a robust cherry flavour, lending a rich, indulgent finish that ties everything together in a harmonious blend. Strawberry Raspberry Cherry is a meticulously crafted e-liquid that stands as a testament to Riot Squad's commitment to quality and flavour. It's perfect for vapers who demand fruity complexity without the fuss, and richness without the sugary heaviness—a truly versatile choice for any fruit lover.
